meta.title: Neighbr shell mock data - Team 2 PinPoint
meta.label: ILLUSTRATIVE SAMPLE DATA. All names, places, events, people and coordinates are invented for the prototype. Not real businesses or records.
meta.corridor: Wyandotte St E, Thompson to Glidden (Olde Riverside, Windsor, Ontario)
meta.coordinatesNote: Pins placed along Wyandotte St E between 42.328108,-82.971001 (Thompson) and 42.329205,-82.965572 (Glidden). Positions of individual businesses are illustrative.
meta.addressNote: House numbers are illustrative, chosen to fit the real 5300-6100 block of Wyandotte St E between Thompson and Glidden.
meta.profilesNote: Owner and business are separate profiles: the business sits in the BIA corridor, the owner is a resident of the city. Resident reports go to the city or ward councillor (responder profiles), not the BIA.
meta.communityNote: KAN-42/48: community organizations, schools and institutions with members, roles, volunteer roles, events and service changes. Events stay private until an organizer approves them; approved events with a place, and library service changes, show on the shared map until they are over.
meta.chatsNote: KAN-51 (Bhavana): sample chats, who each organization may message (its members), and message settings. All illustrative.
